text.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ مَا مَكَّنِّى فِيهِ رَبِّى خَيْرٌۭ فَأَعِينُونِى بِقُوَّةٍ أَجْعَلْ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ رَدْمًا

words.gloss_range: plain reported speech introducing a direct answer, not bargaining or reciprocal disputation
words.root_gloss_range: speech and saying; locally the Form I perfect opens an owned declaration by the prior speaker
words.prose: {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}) resumes the prior figure without renaming him, so the answer starts abruptly as his own speech after the people's proposal in 18:94. The Form I speech verb makes the response a declaration rather than a negotiation: it will first ground sufficiency in the Lord, then convert the proposed payment into commanded cooperation. The same speech opening also belongs to the narrative speech chain, including 18:87 and 18:98, where direct declarations mark staged turns in the narrative.

topics.headline: direct quoted answer after the petition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins with a recovered singular speaker answering the previous plural petition rather than with a fresh narrative summary.
topics.reason: The perfect 3ms speech verb is the reporting head for the quoted utterance, and the subject is recovered from the prior scene.

topics.headline: plain declaration rather than negotiation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the speech act refuses the payment frame and issues direction from within a Lord-centered declaration.
topics.reason: The broader speech-root field is narrowed by the local Form I verb and quotation syntax; causative or reciprocal speech branches are useful contrasts but do not govern the local parse.

topics.headline: same-surah staged speech recurrence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this answer is another staged declaration in the same narrative sequence, with 18:98 later echoing speech tied to the Lord.
topics.reason: The same-surah recurrence is concrete and locally relevant because the present speech launches the refusal-command-construction sequence.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun introducing the provision clause, not negation or condition

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: predicate value term in the same clause

words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) packages the whole prior divine enabling as the subject of the value claim. Because the particle is relative, not negative or conditional, the utterance affirms the provision and waits for {{ar:خَيْرٌ}} ({{tr:khayrun}}) to judge it. The reader therefore hears the refusal of payment as an evaluation of what the Lord has already established, not as a denial or a new condition.

topics.headline: relative subject holding the provision clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the offered payment is answered by a whole Lord-given provision clause treated as the thing declared better.
topics.reason: The particle introduces the relative subject of the nominal clause, and the following predicate evaluates that full embedded clause.

topics.headline: relative parse blocks denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same surface particle could mislead, but here it creates a positive assertion of provision rather than denying empowerment.
topics.reason: Alternative particle values are narrowed away by the relative clause and predicate structure.

words.gloss_range: caused firm establishment of the speaker within a domain; not mere possibility or self-attainment
words.root_gloss_range: firmness, place, station, enablement, and authority; locally Form II and the following prepositional domain select divinely granted operative capacity

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: domain phrase in the same clause

words.prose: {{ar:مَكَّنِّي}} ({{tr:makkannī}}) makes the speaker the recipient of a completed divine establishing before he asks anything from the people. The Form II shape gives the empowerment a firm causative force, while the following {{ar:فِيهِ}} ({{tr:fīhi}}) keeps it situated in a domain rather than reducing it to owned wealth. The same root recalls the earlier establishment in 18:84, so the speech turns the narrator's claim into the speaker's own basis for construction and points toward his later making role. Variant evidence with the fuller object boundary clarifies how tightly the verb is compressed into the first-person object in the common surface, but the local force remains received empowerment, not self-establishment.

topics.headline: speaker as recipient of prior divine establishment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the leader's authority begins as received empowerment before it becomes a command to others.
topics.reason: The perfect Form II verb has the speaker as object and {{ar:رَبِّي}} ({{tr:rabbī}}) as agent, so agency begins with the Lord.

topics.headline: empowerment situated within a domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the empowerment is emplacement within an operative sphere, not simply possession of a substitute payment.
topics.reason: The verb combines the first-person object with the following prepositional pronoun, making recipient and domain both visible.

topics.headline: Form II firmness and authority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb carries firm authorization, while local syntax keeps that authorization tied to the Lord's act rather than to an abstract rank word.
topics.reason: Derivative and branch evidence supports firmness and rank pressure, but the surface verb remains Form II received establishing.

topics.headline: earlier establishment remembered in this claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word ties the present refusal back to the same-surah establishment in 18:84 and forward to the making verb later in the ayah.
topics.reason: The m-k-n recurrence in the same narrative unit and the pairing with the later making verb give the form narrative and constructional force.

topics.headline: variant clarifies the object boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how tightly the empowering act is attached to the first-person recipient, while variant evidence only clarifies the boundary and does not change the meaning.
topics.reason: The variant with a fuller consonantal boundary is valid apparatus for form perception, but it does not replace the local recipient relation.

words.gloss_range: prepositional pronoun marking the sphere in which empowerment occurred

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: relative particle in the same clause
delayed agent in the same clause

words.prose: {{ar:فِيهِ}} ({{tr:fīhi}}) keeps the relative provision active by sending its suffix back to {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}). Its preposition frames the Lord's establishing as a domain or sphere, not as a detachable commodity. Because it stands before {{ar:رَبِّي}} ({{tr:rabbī}}), the clause lets the domain of empowerment surface before naming the giver.

topics.headline: domain marker returning to the relative head
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the empowering provision remains grammatically present as a sphere in which the speaker has been established.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the suffix as a complement to the establishment verb and resumes the relative pronoun.

topics.headline: domain before agent and instrument
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the division between the Lord-given domain and the later human instrument, with the domain named before the empowering agent appears.
topics.reason: The local order places the prepositional phrase before the subject, and the later instrumental phrase creates a real contrast in means.

words.gloss_range: my Lord as the delayed agent of empowerment and source of the value claim
words.root_gloss_range: lordship, mastery, sustaining care, and nurture; locally the possessive construct identifies the speaker's Lord as the empowering agent

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: establishment verb in the same clause
predicate value term in the same clause

words.prose: {{ar:رَبِّي}} ({{tr:rabbī}}) arrives as the delayed agent of {{ar:مَكَّنِّي}} ({{tr:makkannī}}), so the giver is named after the domain of empowerment has already been held before the listener. The construct with the first-person suffix makes the relation personally definite: the speaker's own Lord is the source of the sufficiency that {{ar:خَيْرٌ}} ({{tr:khayrun}}) will name. The root's lordship and nurturing range gives the empowerment the feel of cultivated authority, not raw power.

topics.headline: personally definite empowering agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the power behind the refusal is not generic authority but the speaker's own acknowledged Lord as grammatical agent.
topics.reason: The noun is construct with a first-person suffix and functions as the subject of the establishment verb.

topics.headline: Lordship grounds the better claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the claim of superiority is grounded in who gave the empowerment, not only in comparison with tribute.
topics.reason: The word supplies the source of the empowerment evaluated by the following predicate.

topics.headline: nurture and authority within the agent role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Lordship carries sustaining and cultivating force, while the local grammar keeps that force attached to the empowerment act.
topics.reason: The root range supports nurturing lordship, but the local topic is the agentive source of establishment rather than a broad theology of the root.

words.gloss_range: better, superior good, and value language answering the prior payment offer
words.root_gloss_range: goodness, preference, choice, and wealth; locally comparative/evaluative value over the whole relative clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: relative particle in the same clause
instrumental strength noun in the same command
barrier object in the result clause

words.prose: {{ar:خَيْرٌ}} ({{tr:khayrun}}) is the predicate that finally evaluates the whole clause opened by {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}). It answers the offered tribute from 18:94 without repeating it: what the Lord established is better. Because the root can carry goodness and wealth-value, the word lets the refusal meet a payment offer with a superior form of value rather than with mere disdain for resources. Within Surah 18, it also joins the comparative-value thread seen at 18:36, 18:46, and 18:81. Its indefinite ending begins an audible noun thread with {{ar:قُوَّةٍ}} ({{tr:quwwatin}}) and {{ar:رَدْمًا}} ({{tr:radman}}).

topics.headline: predicate judging the whole provision clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the refusal works through a nominal value judgment about Lord-given provision, not through a direct rebuke of the offer.
topics.reason: The word is the nominative predicate of the relative subject and makes the completed clause evaluative.

topics.headline: better than the proposed tribute
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word can meet the financial offer on value-language terrain while choosing the Lord-given provision as superior.
topics.reason: The prior offer in 18:94 supplies the comparandum for the comparative value claim.

topics.headline: surah value thread and noun cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this value word joins Surah 18's wider comparative-value pattern, including 18:36, 18:46, and 18:81, while its sound links provision, strength, and barrier.
topics.reason: The inter-ayah references are concrete and the local noun cadence ties three key nouns in the ayah.

words.gloss_range: causal/result hinge from sufficiency claim to imperative request

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: imperative in the following command

words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) is the hinge between declaration and command. It scopes over the whole statement that the Lord-given provision is better, then attaches directly to {{ar:أَعِينُونِي}} ({{tr:aʿīnūnī}}), making the request for help a consequence of the refusal rather than a new bargain. The small particle therefore turns value judgment into practical labor demand.

topics.headline: therefore from provision to command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command is caused by the Lord-sufficiency claim, so refusal and labor request form one speech act.
topics.reason: The particle is locally attached to the imperative and links the preceding complete nominal clause to the following request.

topics.headline: fused transition into the imperative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the transition and the command arrive as one written and pronounced movement.
topics.reason: The conjunction is proclitic on the imperative surface, so the form supports the discourse hinge.

words.gloss_range: plural imperative to give practical help to the speaker under his direction
words.root_gloss_range: help and assistance alongside separate nominal branches such as eye or spring; locally the imperative plus instrument selects practical assistance

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: instrumental strength phrase in the same command

words.prose: {{ar:أَعِينُونِي}} ({{tr:aʿīnūnī}}) changes the social arrangement: the people who offered payment in 18:94 are now commanded to help the speaker. The plural imperative addresses them, while the first-person object makes him the immediate recipient of help; their strength is to pass through his direction before becoming construction. The help-root comparison with 1:5 is useful only as a directional contrast: here a divinely grounded human leader commands human assistance, and the following {{ar:بِقُوَّةٍ}} ({{tr:bi-quwwatin}}) narrows the help to practical force rather than eye or spring imagery.

topics.headline: petitioners become commanded helpers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the offered transaction is transformed into participation by the same people who asked for help.
topics.reason: The 2mp imperative addresses the petitioning group and makes the speaker the object of their assistance.

topics.headline: help routed through the leader
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a layered work model: many supply help, but the making role remains with the empowered speaker.
topics.reason: The imperative has a first-person object, an instrumental phrase, and a following first-person making verb.

topics.headline: help branch fixed against other root branches
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word demands rendered assistance, not mutual partnership and not the root's eye or spring branches.
topics.reason: The local imperative and instrumental strength phrase select the assistance branch and exclude unrelated nominal branches.

topics.headline: help formula contrast with 1:5
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a directional contrast with 1:5: divine help is sought there, while human help is commanded here under a divinely empowered speaker.
topics.reason: The echo is concrete and useful as contrast, but it does not redefine the local human imperative.

words.gloss_range: instrumental preposition binding the command to usable strength

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: instrumental strength noun in the same command

words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) narrows the help-command to a means: the people are to help through strength. As a bound preposition before {{ar:قُوَّةٍ}} ({{tr:quwwatin}}), it keeps strength dependent on the imperative rather than making it an independent object, price, or slogan. The accepted contribution is therefore instrumental capacity.

topics.headline: help through strength
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the requested help is specified as a means, so strength becomes the channel of cooperation.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the following genitive noun as the instrument for the imperative.

topics.headline: clitic binding of resource to command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that strength is grammatically attached to the command and cannot stand as a separate offer parallel to tribute.
topics.reason: The proclitic form binds the preposition to the resource noun.

words.gloss_range: usable strength, force, or capacity supplied as the instrument of help
words.root_gloss_range: power, strength, ability, and reinforcement; locally practical construction capacity rather than abstract status

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: instrumental preposition in the same phrase
making verb in the result clause
barrier object in the result clause

words.prose: {{ar:قُوَّةٍ}} ({{tr:quwwatin}}) is genitive under {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}), so strength is the instrument by which the people help, not the direct object of the command. Its indefiniteness leaves the contribution type open, while the sequence toward {{ar:أَجْعَلْ}} ({{tr:ajʿal}}) and {{ar:رَدْمًا}} ({{tr:radman}}) makes the strength concrete: labor, force, tools, or capacity that can be turned into construction. The reinforcement branch remains a local fit for the coming barrier, but the surface contribution is human and instrumental. The word replaces tribute from 18:94 with usable force.

topics.headline: strength as governed means
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the people contribute an instrument of work, not an object, beneficiary, or payment.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the noun as instrumental genitive.

topics.headline: open-ended usable capacity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the requested strength is not narrowly money or abstract power but open-ended force usable for the barrier work.
topics.reason: The indefinite verbal noun is positioned between the help imperative and construction promise.

topics.headline: strength replacing tribute and fitting reinforcement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that strength is the accepted non-monetary support, with reinforcement imagery fitting the coming barrier while remaining locally human and instrumental.
topics.reason: Root and echo evidence enrich the local resource sense, but the surface does not make a divine-name topic or an abstract theology of strength primary.

words.gloss_range: I will make or render as a result of the commanded assistance
words.root_gloss_range: make, place, render, appoint, begin; locally the construction sense is selected by the locative frame and barrier object

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: paired between-phrase locative frame
barrier object in the result clause

words.prose: {{ar:أَجْعَلْ}} ({{tr:ajʿal}}) is the promise/result after the command: help me, and I will make. Its first-person singular form keeps final making with the empowered speaker even after the plural command has enlisted the people. The verb organizes both location and product, with {{ar:بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ}} ({{tr:baynakum wa-baynahum}}) giving the spatial frame and {{ar:رَدْمًا}} ({{tr:radman}}) naming what will be produced; that frame selects construction rather than appointing or merely beginning. It also answers the community's proposed making in 18:94 and opens the same-root execution arc in 18:96.

topics.headline: jussive result after the imperative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that construction is promised as the consequence of cooperation, not as payment for tribute.
topics.reason: The apocopated first-person verb follows the imperative and functions as a result clause.

topics.headline: singular agency gathers plural help
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the people supply force while the empowered speaker remains the accountable maker.
topics.reason: The first-person active form contrasts with the preceding plural imperative and the prior proposal in 18:94.

topics.headline: construction sense selected by frame and object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb produces a barrier in a two-sided location, while broader appointing or beginning senses are not active here.
topics.reason: The locative frame and accusative object select concrete making or rendering over other branches.

topics.headline: proposal answered and execution anticipated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb absorbs the prior proposal in 18:94 and points forward to execution in 18:96 and later assessment in 18:98.
topics.reason: The same root recurs across the local construction sequence and is tied to the boundary shift from proposal to promise.

words.gloss_range: between you, the first addressed endpoint of the barrier's relational location
words.root_gloss_range: between, separation, distinction, and clarity; locally spatial separation is primary with clarity as local pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: barrier object in the result clause

words.prose: {{ar:بَيْنَكُمْ}} ({{tr:baynakum}}) makes the addressees one endpoint of the construction site. The suffix changes the people's earlier inclusive framing in 18:94 into direct address: the protected side is now "you," not a group that includes the speaker. As the first half of the repeated between-phrase, it makes the barrier's location relational before {{ar:رَدْمًا}} ({{tr:radman}}) is named. The root's clarity field remains a pressure, but the local form is spatial.

topics.headline: protected addressees as first endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the speaker reformulates the people's geography from inclusive petition into direct protected addressees.
topics.reason: The second-person plural suffix identifies the addressed people as the first locative endpoint.

topics.headline: first half of the paired between-frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the barrier's geometry before the object appears: two explicit endpoints with a constructed middle.
topics.reason: The repeated suffixed between-phrases create a balanced locative frame preceding the object.

topics.headline: spatial separation with latent clarity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the physical between-phrase also makes the social distinction clear, while the surface remains spatial rather than a clarifying verb.
topics.reason: The root family supports clarity pressure, but the actual form is the spatial adverb governed by the making verb.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction joining the two between-phrases as equal endpoints

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: first between-phrase endpoint
second between-phrase endpoint

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the two between-phrases equal. It coordinates {{ar:بَيْنَكُمْ}} ({{tr:baynakum}}) and {{ar:بَيْنَهُمْ}} ({{tr:baynahum}}), so the barrier is not merely near one side or against the other; it is located by both endpoints. Its brevity also preserves the mirror-like cadence of the two phrases before the heavier object arrives.

topics.headline: equal endpoints coordinated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the construction zone depends on two balanced endpoints rather than a one-sided relation.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the second between-phrase with the first under the making verb's locative frame.

topics.headline: light connector preserving phrase symmetry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the balanced phrasing remains audible because the connector is short and does not overtake the mirrored endpoints.
topics.reason: The cadence claim is secondary but locally tied to the repeated between-phrases.

words.gloss_range: between them, the second endpoint referring back to the named hostile group in 18:94
words.root_gloss_range: between, separation, distinction, and clarity; locally spatial separation with referential carry-over

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: first between-phrase endpoint

words.prose: {{ar:بَيْنَهُمْ}} ({{tr:baynahum}}) completes the locative mirror begun by {{ar:بَيْنَكُمْ}} ({{tr:baynakum}}). Its suffix carries forward the named group from 18:94, so the blocked side is not renamed but must be recovered; any broader hostile-force resonance stays subordinate to that antecedent. The endpoint remains stable while the protected side has shifted to direct address, and the repeated between-structure makes the barrier's two-sided geometry audible and clear.

topics.headline: third-person endpoint carried from 18:94
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the blocked side is carried forward by pronoun from 18:94, with any broader hostile-force resonance kept subordinate to that referent.
topics.reason: The referent evidence identifies the suffix with the group named in 18:94; broader generalization is only a secondary resonance.

topics.headline: second half of the governed locative frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the barrier is located between two syntactically matched sides before the object closes the clause.
topics.reason: The second repeated between-phrase completes the coordinated locative frame under the making verb.

topics.headline: spatial separation clarifies the other side
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the far side becomes a spatially intelligible counterpart, while the local form remains a between-adverb rather than a clarification verb.
topics.reason: The b-y-n clarity field is locally useful but narrowed by the actual spatial construction.

words.gloss_range: a produced compacted barrier or filled embankment, not merely a generic wall
words.root_gloss_range: filling, closing, compacting, and the resulting filled obstruction; locally a unique produced barrier object between two groups

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: making verb in the result clause

words.prose: {{ar:رَدْمًا}} ({{tr:radman}}) is the promised product of {{ar:أَجْعَلْ}} ({{tr:ajʿal}}), distinct from the preceding between-frame. Its accusative, indefinite form presents a new barrier-kind to be made, and its lexical force points to filling and compacting a breach rather than merely naming a simple wall. That matters because the people requested a wall term in 18:94 after earlier barriers in 18:93, but the answer ends with a more engineered, massive term. The word is also exceptional as the supplied single occurrence of the root in the Quran, sonically heavy, and open toward the materials command of 18:96; variant-reading evidence can make that forward pull even sharper.

topics.headline: accusative product of the making promise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah ends on the produced object, not merely on the location between the groups.
topics.reason: The noun is accusative as the object or result of the making verb and is distinct from the locative frame.

topics.headline: layered fill replacing the requested wall
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the speaker does not merely repeat the people's wall word from 18:94 but promises a compacted fill-barrier fitted to strength and the gap between the groups.
topics.reason: Dictionary and contextual rows support a process-product barrier noun, and the prior scene supplies the lexical contrast with the requested wall.

topics.headline: variant boundary pulls toward execution
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the barrier noun closes the promise while already leaning toward the materials command in 18:96; variant evidence can make that hinge explicit.
topics.reason: Accepted variant-boundary evidence is useful for the promise-to-execution hinge, but the canonical local clause still ends with the barrier object.

topics.headline: unique heavy lexical endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah lands on a rare, dense-sounding word whose uniqueness and cadence make the promised obstruction lexically weighty.
topics.reason: The supplied corpus count and sound rows are locally tied to the final object and do not conflict with the grammatical analysis.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مَا مَكَّنِّى فِيهِ رَبِّى ... فَأَعِينُونِى بِقُوَّةٍ ... رَدْمًا
baseline_models.mechanism: Capacity attributed to the Lord is not retained as solitary power: it solicits assistance, gathers strength, and closes a breach. Authority functions as stewardship that converts distributed contribution into repair.

activation_trace.role: Effective capacity supplies the entrusted competence from which the project begins.
Progressive repair and completion make lordly nurture the source-pattern for stewardship.
Mutual aid makes local participation operational rather than decorative.
Strength assembled like cable strands images many contributions becoming one load-bearing force.
Closing a breach specifies the product as repair of a vulnerable opening.

changed_reading.before: A powerful ruler offers to build a wall.
changed_reading.after: A steward of received capacity organizes communal force to repair a specific breach.

baseline_models.mechanism: Making, the doubled interval, and breach-filling form a relational mechanism: the intervention transforms a vulnerable between into a governed boundary. It manages contact rather than erasing either side.

activation_trace.role: Transformation into a new condition makes boundary management an active social-spatial operation.
The interval between two parties supplies the precise spatial field being reorganized.
A connection standing between parties keeps the boundary relational even while it separates.
Breach closure gives the governed interval a concrete protective form.

changed_reading.before: An object is placed between two groups.
changed_reading.after: A vulnerable intergroup interval is transformed into a managed boundary.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier enabling is paired with a connecting means, and that means is repeatedly followed. The focus claim therefore names an endowed, practiced capacity whose next use is cooperative construction.

activation_trace.role: Effective capacity anchors the focus claim in usable competence.
The repeated grant of capacity identifies the focus competence as prior endowment.
A cord-like connection turns endowment into an actionable means linking capacity to an objective.
Tracking step after step converts the available means into a pursued method.

structural_cues: 18:84 repeats م ك ن before granting a sabab; 18:85, 18:89, and 18:92 repeat the act of following a sabab.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enabling plus repeatedly followed means; I identify the focus's 'what my Lord enabled me in' with that endowment and treat this project as its next procedural use. It could instead be generic retrospective gratitude.

changed_reading.before: He possesses resources superior to what others can supply.
changed_reading.after: He exercises a divinely supplied capacity by following means and recruiting the community into the next step.

context_deltas.mechanism: A group that scarcely understands speech receives a short operational utterance, followed by repeated commands embedded in shared work. Material coordination becomes a practical communication interface.

activation_trace.role: Voiced speech launches an instruction whose meaning can be enacted.
Mutual assistance supplies the shared action through which the instruction becomes legible.
Difficulty grasping meaning creates the communicative constraint that action must bridge.
Speech itself is the stated domain of difficulty, sharpening the shift toward executable saying.
Repeated voiced directives segment the shared task into materially demonstrable stages.

structural_cues: 18:93 states near-failure of speech understanding; 18:95-96 answers with brief imperatives and coordinated operations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies speech difficulty, saying, assistance, and repeated directives; I infer that bodily and material coordination can function as translation. The alternative is simple narrative compression with no communicative design.

changed_reading.before: The focus speech merely reports a construction proposal.
changed_reading.after: The speech is executable coordination whose meaning is carried by shared work despite linguistic friction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The site already lies between two barriers, and the community requests a sadd; the focus instead names a radm while repeating the two-sided interval. The work reads as terrain-integrated infill of an existing gap, not a freestanding total enclosure.

activation_trace.role: The doubled interval locates the intervention strictly between opposing sides.
Filling an opening recasts the requested barrier as closure of a specific breach.
The interval between two existing features supplies the construction's terrain-bound site.
Existing blockage on both sides defines a residual gap rather than open terrain.
The community's doubled between frames protection as control of one intergroup corridor.
Their requested blockage provides the generic design that the focus sharpens into breach-filling.

structural_cues: The noun sequence moves from dual sadds in 18:93, to a requested sadd in 18:94, to radm in 18:95.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the terrain, repeated between-construction, and noun shift; I assume the shift from sadd to radm is functionally informative. The live alternative is ordinary synonymic variation.

changed_reading.before: He agrees to erect a generic wall.
changed_reading.after: He redesigns the request as targeted infill that joins existing terrain and seals its vulnerable corridor.

context_deltas.mechanism: The community identifies a loss of order and offers a specified outgoing payment. The focus answers with Lord-given capacity and a demand for shared force, shifting protection from purchased service to co-produced public repair.

activation_trace.role: Entrusted capacity displaces payment as the builder's operative resource.
Useful good evaluates the response by benefit and rectification rather than price.
Mutual aid replaces the passive role of payer with active participation.
Aggregated force names the nonmonetary contribution required from the community.
Departure from sound order defines the public harm the work must rectify.
Money disbursed on a specified basis gives the proposal its transactional form.

structural_cues: The offer 'shall we assign you a payment' is answered by 'what my Lord enabled me in is better; assist me with strength.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies payment, refusal by comparison, and requested assistance; I infer that participation redistributes agency and future ownership of protection. The alternative is a merely logistical preference for labor over money.

changed_reading.before: He declines a fee because he is already wealthier.
changed_reading.after: He refuses outsourced protection and converts clients into co-producers of a public repair.

context_deltas.mechanism: The vague request for strength unfolds as modules, resistant iron, equalizing geometry, forced air, heat, and a molten-metal pour; the result is then tested against going over and boring through. Strength is an ordered composite system, not a homogeneous quantity.

activation_trace.role: Bundled strand-like strength supplies the focus category that the later operations unpack.
Gathered blocks provide modular mass for the composite.
Hard, resistant iron supplies the load-bearing substrate.
Equalization between two sides turns placement into controlled geometry.
Driving air into the work supplies the thermal transformation stage.
Molten copper supplies a poured binding or facing layer.
Capacity, twice negated, turns the next two actions into performance verdicts.
Elevation and overcoming define the over-the-top failure mode the structure defeats.
Opening a passage through something defines the penetration failure mode the structure defeats.

structural_cues: 18:96 orders distinct materials and transformations; 18:97 separately negates ascent and perforation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies modules, hardness, equalization, airflow, molten metal, and two negated capabilities; I treat this sequence as the content of 'strength' and the two verbs as design criteria. Alternatives are manpower alone and a rhetorically exhaustive outcome statement.

changed_reading.before: The community is asked to contribute brute force to a massive wall.
changed_reading.after: The community supplies an integrated manufacturing process whose geometry and material layers answer two distinct attack paths.

context_deltas.mechanism: The completed barrier is immediately named mercy from the same Lord, then assigned a certain future flattening at the Lord's appointed promise. Its goodness is delegated and time-bounded, not monumental permanence.

activation_trace.role: Nurture and completion ground the builder's present capacity in continuing stewardship.
Making into a condition leaves the artifact open to a later contrary transformation.
Present breach closure supplies the useful but finite protective state.
Merciful tenderness identifies protection, rather than self-display, as the work's immediate value.
Repeated lordship and ownership assign both the structure's value and its endpoint beyond the builder.
An appointment bounded by time places the structure's removal on a fixed horizon.
A second transformation reverses the protective condition produced in the focus.
Demolition to level ground specifies the artifact's promised material reversal.
Reality-confirming truth makes the future reversal certain rather than hypothetical.

structural_cues: The demonstrative 'this' follows the completed work, and the same verse moves from present mercy to a future conditional demolition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies 'this' as mercy and a certain future flattening; I connect the demonstrative to the completed work and treat expiry as a limit on stewardship. The alternatives are a broader reference to the episode and a purely eschatological contrast.

changed_reading.before: The focus announces a durable monument of protective power.
changed_reading.after: It initiates a provisional mercy whose useful lifespan and eventual removal remain under the giver of capacity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: A wall-as-connection is surprising because the dominant physical function is separation. It remains anchored in the doubled between, the packet's connection branch, cooperative aid, and patching; downstream prose should carry it as a relational overlay, not deny the barrier's exclusionary function.

activation_trace.role: Mutual aid gives the boundary a jointly produced social bond.
A standing connection between parties lets the separating interval also function as an interface.
Patching by attaching parts images the structure as a join across a torn spatial fabric.
Equalizing two sides gives physical form to the relational join.

changed_reading.before: The barrier only separates one population from another.
changed_reading.after: The barrier also materializes a jointly made interface in the interval it closes.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant q-w-l to q-l-l mapping. It remains anchored by the focus saying, its imperative burden, and collective force; downstream prose should label it an activation or wordplay, never a lexical gloss of qāla.

activation_trace.role: Actual voiced saying keeps the exploratory activation attached to the focus form.
Carrying and rising turns the utterance into an assumption and elevation of a shared burden.
Mutual aid distributes the burden enacted by the command.
Bundled strength gives the raised undertaking a collective load-bearing form.
Repeated commands continue to carry and raise the undertaking through successive stages.

changed_reading.after: His saying performatively shoulders and raises a cooperative undertaking.

strongest_changes: Earlier enabling became a followed means rather than static private capacity.
A paid generic sadd became co-produced, terrain-specific radm.
Strength unfolded into staged composite engineering tested against ascent and perforation.
The completed protection became a temporary mercy with a certain endpoint.
summary.what_was_special: The focus concentrates the pericope's shifts: endowment becomes method, speech becomes shared work, payment becomes participation, a generic barrier becomes breach-specific infill, and durable engineering is immediately relativized by promised demolition.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the sadd-to-radm shift carries technical precision or ordinary synonymic variation.
Whether action-as-translation exceeds the narrative's terse presentation.
Whether the connection branch of bayn and the q-w-l to q-l-l activation are productive overlays rather than intended senses.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Received good is converted into participatory strength.** `خ ي ر` B001 qualifies what `ر ب ب` B001 has established for the ruler; he declines tribute but requests their force. I infer a causal chain from divine enablement to leader’s design to communal labor. The ayah reads just power as capacity multiplication, not monetized substitution for the people’s agency.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:96 revealed that the ruler’s “I will make” depends materially on the people’s supplied strength and pieces.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Barrier-building as communal mending.** `ر د م/B001` is filling a breach into a barrier; `ر د م/B002` is patching worn cloth. The doubled `بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ` identifies a social tear, the request `فَأَعِينُونِي بِقُوَّةٍ` distributes agency, and 18:96 layers pieces into a fused structure. I infer that the threat is treated as a breach in a collective fabric rather than a product to be purchased. `رَدْمًا` reads as cooperative repair whose strength comes from joined contributions.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:96–98 realized cloth-like mending as fused layers, denied passage, and a barrier whose useful life remains bounded by promise.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: A Fixed Promise Ends Temporary Arrangements
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Concealment, delay, material protection, and claims of permanence remain subordinate to a divinely fixed temporal boundary.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Sleep, a garden, delayed punishment, a rampart, and final lodging are all evaluated by who controls their duration.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The Protective Rampart Ends When the Promise Arrives

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: Fire Reverses from Punitive Enclosure to Protective Fabrication

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Fire is not assigned one fixed polarity; disciplined use reverses its role without weakening its force.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Controlled Fire Fuses a Defensive Surface
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Blowing turns aligned iron masses into fire before molten copper is poured over them to close a breach.

يدخل فيه قولة وقوال وقوالة وتقوالة وقؤول ومقوال ومقول إذا وصفت الإنسان بأنه لسن أو كثير القول أو منطيق.
يدخل فيه المقول أو القيل بلغة أهل اليمن، والواحد القيل، والجمع المقاولة والأقيال والأقوال، وملك حمير دون الملك الأعظم، والمرأة قيلة.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه تقول باطلا، وتقول عليه أي كذب عليه، وقولتني أو أقولتني ما لم أقل.
يدخل فيه اقتال قولا إذا اجتر إلى نفسه قولا من خير أو شر.
يدخل فيه القالة الحسنة أو القبيحة المنتشرة في الناس، وكثرة قالة الناس، والقيل والقال بوصفهما حديثا دائرا.
يدخل فيه القال، الخشبة التي تضرب بها القلة.
يدخل فيه قاولته في أمره وتقاولنا إذا تفاوضنا.
يدخل فيه اقتال عليه إذا كان بمعنى تحكم.
يدخل فيه تقول إذا أجري مجرى تظن في العمل، وخاصة في الاستفهام، وما ذكر عن بني سليم من إجراء متصرف قلت مجرى الظن في غير الاستفهام.
يدخل فيه المتصور في النفس قبل الإبراز باللفظ، كما في قول في نفسي لم أظهره.
يدخل فيه القول بمعنى الاعتقاد، نحو فلان يقول بقول أبي حنيفة.
يدخل فيه القول للدلالة على الشيء، مثل امتلأ الحوض وقال قطني.
يدخل فيه فلان يقول بكذا إذا كان معناه العناية الصادقة بالشيء.
يدخل فيه استعمال المنطقيين القول بمعنى الحد، كقول الجوهر وقول العرض أي حدهما.
يدخل فيه القول في الإلهام، حيث يسمى إلقاء المعنى قولا من غير خطاب وارد.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yükü taşıma veya taşıyabilme ile öznenin yükselip harekete geçmesini aynı kolda açıkça toplar; kuşun uçuşa kalkması, göğün yükselmesi ve yolcuların yüklenip ayrılması ayrı katılımcı gerçekleşmeleridir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yük taşıma ile yükselme çekirdek çizgileri ayrılır; ağır bulut taşıma, uçuşa kalkma ve yolcuların ayrılması yalnızca kendi özne ve yapılarında geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir yükü kaldırıp taşıyabilmeyi veya üstlenmeyi ve bir öznenin yükselerek harekete geçmesini bildirir. İkinci çizgi kuşun uçuşa kalkmasını, göğün yükselmesini ve yolcuların yüklenip yola koyulmasını kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi kaldıracak gücü bulmak, onu taşımak veya yük olarak üstlenmektir.
Bir öznenin aşağıdaki konumundan yükselmesi veya kuş gibi harekete ve uçuşa başlamasıdır.
Yolcuların yüklerini alıp bulundukları yerden ayrılarak yolculuğa başlamasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar bir yükü kaldırıp taşıma ile yukarı kalkarak harekete geçme çizgilerini bir araya getirir; kuş, gök, bulut ve yolcu örnekleri katılımcıya göre bu iki çizgiyi somutlaştırır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yeterlik ve denetim çekirdeği korunur; birine olanak sağlama, bir işin yapılabilirliği ve yönetim gücü, kendi özel yapıları içinde ayrı yüzler olarak tanımlanır.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimsenin bir şeyi yapabilir hâle getirilmesini veya o şey üzerinde yeterlik ve denetim kazanmasını anlatır. Bir işin yapılabilir oluşunu, kişinin ona gücünün yetip yetmediğini ve yönetim gücüne sahip olmayı da kapsar.

facets.statement: Birine bir şeyi yapma gücü ve olanağı vermek anlatılır.

Bir işin kişi için yapılabilir veya erişilebilir olması ve bunun olumsuzlanması anlatılır.
Yönetim alanında etkili güç ve yetki sahibi olma özel bir kullanım oluşturur.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الرب: الله تبارك وتعالى؛ ورب كل شيء مالكه (jamhara); رب كل شئ: مالكه؛ وقد قالوه في الجاهلية للملك؛ رببت القوم: سستهم (sihah); يكون الرب: المالك؛ ويكون الرب: السيد المطاع؛ ويكون الرب: المصلح (tahdhib); الرب مصدر مستعار للفاعل؛ لا يقال الرب مطلقا إلا لله؛ رب الدار ورب الفرس (mufradat); فالرب المالك والخالق والصاحب؛ والله جل ثناؤه الرب (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, bir şeyi gözeterek düzeltme, geliştirme ve aşama aşama tamamlanmış duruma getirme sürecini tutarlı biçimde gösterir. Çocuk yetiştirme, mülkü iyileştirme ve yapılan iyiliği tamamlama bu sürecin farklı nesneleridir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Eylemin yalın gelişim çekirdeği ile çocuk, mülk ve yapılan iyilik gibi nesnelere bağlı kullanımları ayrıştırılarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi sürekli gözetim altında düzeltmek, geliştirmek ve aşama aşama tamamlanmış durumuna ulaştırmaktır.

facets.statement: Süreç, gözetilen şeyi eksik durumdan tamamlanmış duruma doğru geliştirir.
Çocuk yetiştirme, bir mülkü iyileştirme ve yapılan iyiliği tamamlama başlıca uygulamalardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar düzeltme, sürekli bakım, yetiştirme ve tamamlama öğelerini tek bir aşamalı gelişim sürecinde birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bakımın gelişme, düzeltme ve tamamlanma sonucuna yöneldiği bütün genel bağlamlarda kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Aşamalı gelişim, bakım, düzeltme ve tamamlanma öğelerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir çocuğun veya canlı varlığın gelişimini üstlenme bağlamında doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Sürekli bakım yoluyla gelişip olgunlaştırma sürecini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Mülk, iş veya yapılan iyilik gibi bir nesneyi eksiksiz duruma getirme bağlamında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Düzeltme ve tamamlanmış duruma ulaştırma sonucunu korur.
Gözetim ve ilgilenme yönünü kısmen korur.
error_profile.loses: Düzeltme, aşamalı geliştirme ve tamamlanmış duruma ulaştırma sonucunu kaybeder.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Gözetilen şeyi aşama aşama geliştirme ve tamamlanmış duruma ulaştırma sonucu odak dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Aralıklı yoklama, öğüt verme ve çevresel bakım gibi tamamlanma gerektirmeyen kullanımlar komşuda bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir şeyin bakımını üstlenme, onu düzeltme ve iyi durumda tutma alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal gelişim sürecini tamamlanma sınırına taşır; komşu dal ise bakımın yinelenmesini ve gözetimi sonuçtan bağımsız olarak kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; bakım ile tamamlama arasındaki en ince sınırı gösteren aday seçildi, yalnız büyüme, akrabalık veya olgunluk alanını paylaşanlar dışarıda bırakıldı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه رب الشيء إذا أصلحه وأتمه وقام عليه، ورب النعمة والصنيعة والضيعة والولد والصبي، والتربية حالا فحالا
branches.source_phrase_ar: رب الرجل النعمة يربها ربا؛ ربابة أيضا إذا تممها (jamhara); رب الضيعة أي أصلحها وأتمها؛ رب فلان ولده؛ رباه (sihah); رب الشيء أي أصلحه؛ رب فلان الصنيعة إذا أتمها وأصلحها (tahdhib); التربية، وهو إنشاء الشيء حالا فحالا إلى حد التمام؛ ربه ورباه ورببه (mufradat); رب فلان ضيعته إذا قام على إصلاحها؛ رببت الصبي أربه (maqayis); ربته تربيتا إذا رببه (maqayis-rbt)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الرباني والربانيون بمعنى العلماء والحكماء وأهل العلم بالرب أو من يرب العلم ونفسه به
يدخل فيه الربة والجماعات الكثيرة، والربيون إذا فسروا بالألوف أو الجماعات، ورباب القبائل لاجتماعهم
يدخل فيه الربيب والربيبة للولد المربوب من زوج سابق، والراب والرابة لمن يقوم على أمره، والحاضنة
يدخل فيه الرُّبّ الطلاء الخاثر أو ثفل السمن والزيت، والسقاء والنحي والأديم والدواء والطعام إذا جعل فيه الرُّبّ أو أصلح به
يدخل فيه رب أو أرب بالمكان إذا أقام، ومرب الإبل ومرابها، وأربت السحابة أو الجنوب إذا دامت، والإرباب بمعنى الدنو
يدخل فيه الرباب والربابة للسحاب، والسحاب المتعلق أو المركب بعضه على بعض، وما سمي بذلك لتربية النبات أو دوام المطر
يدخل فيه الشاة الرُّبّى والرباب لقرب العهد بالولادة أو لزوم البيت للبن، وربان الشيء بمعنى حدثانه وطراءته، وربى الشباب
يدخل فيه الربابة للجلدة أو الوعاء الذي تجمع فيه القداح أو سهام الميسر، وجماعة السهام نفسها
يدخل فيه الربابة والرباب للعهد والميثاق والجوار، والأربة للمعاهدين، والرباب للعشور إذا جعل كالعهد
يدخل فيه الربة والربب لضرب من الشجر أو النبت أو البقلة التي تبقى خضراء
يدخل فيه الربب للماء الكثير، ويقال للعذب، من جهة اجتماع الماء
يدخل فيه الربرب لقطيع بقر الوحش، وقيل لجماعة البقر أو الإبل
يدخل فيه رب وربما وربت وربه كحرف خافض أو حرف معنى للتقليل، ودخول ما أو التاء أو الهاء عليه
يدخل فيه الربى بمعنى الحاجة، والرابة، والعقدة المحكمة، والنعمة والإحسان
يدخل فيه الرباني لرئيس الملاحين

root_profile.summary: Kök, sahiplik ve yetiştirmeden topluluk, aile bağı, kalıcılık, bulut, yiyecek maddesi, sözleşme, bitki, su, hayvan sürüsü, dil bilgisel öğe ve gemi yönetimine uzanan on yedi ayrı anlam dalı taşır. Dalların çoğu yönetme, bir araya getirme veya süreklilik çağrışımlarıyla gevşekçe ilişkilense de sözlükte bağımsız sınırlar gerektirir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ربا الشيء إذا زاد أو ارتفع، وربت الأرض إذا انتفخت وزادت، والرابي الزائد أو العالي، وأربى عليه إذا أشرف أو زاد عليه.
يدخل فيه الربوة والرابية والرباوة والرباة وما ارتفع من الأرض، مع اختلاف لغات الكلمة.
يدخل فيه الربا في البيع أو القرض، والزيادة على رأس المال، والربية لغة أو اسم خاص للربا.
يدخل فيه الربو بمعنى النفس العالي أو البهر أو الانبهار، وما يصيب الإنسان أو الدابة من علو النفس أو الانتفاخ من مشي أو عدو أو فزع.
يدخل فيه ربيت الولد أو تربيته بمعنى غذوته، وربا الولد أو الزرع بالنماء، وربوت أو ربيت في القوم بمعنى نشأت فيهم.
يدخل فيه الأربية أو الأربيتان بمعنى أصل الفخذ أو لحمتين ناتئتين في أصول الفخذين من باطن.
يدخل فيه قولهم جاء في أربية قومه أي في أهل بيته من بني الأعمام ونحوهم.

root_profile.summary: Kökün merkezinde artma ve yükselme bulunur; bu çekirdek yükselmiş araziye, işlemde anaparayı aşan koşullu fazlalığa, yükselip sıkışan soluğa ve beslenerek büyümeye uzanır. Ayrıca uyluk kökü anatomisi ile baba tarafından yakın hane halkını anlatan dar bir ifade, merkezden ayrı sözlüksel dallar oluşturur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, herkesin yöneldiği ve arzuladığı genel olumlu değeri kötülüğün karşıtı olarak kurar; ayrıca bağlama göre kötülüğe ya da zarara karşı konabildiğini belirtir. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu genel çekirdeği ve yarar yönünü doğru biçimde yansıtır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalın genel değer anlamıyla sınırlıdır; seçim, mal veya armağanla ilgili özel dalların anlamları buraya taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: İnsanların yöneldiği ve arzu ettiği, kötülüğün karşıtı olan genel olumlu değerdir; bağlama göre yarar yönü öne çıkabilir ve zarara da karşı konabilir.

facets.statement: Herkesçe arzu edilen ve kötülüğün karşısında duran genel olumlu değeri bildirir.
Bağlama göre yarar yönü belirginleşebilir ve kavram zararın karşısına da yerleştirilebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği, insanların yöneldiği genel olumlu değerin kötülüğün karşıtı olmasıdır. Bu değer bazı bağlamlarda yarar yönüyle belirginleşerek zararla karşıtlık da kurar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Genel olumlu değerin kötülüğe karşı konduğu ve insanların ona yöneldiği yalın kullanımlar için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Arzu edilen ve kötülüğün karşısında duran olumlu değer çekirdeğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Yarar, üstünlük veya düzgünlük yönünün bağlama göre ayrıca öne çıkabilmesini açıkça göstermez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Olumlu değerin doğrudan kötülüğün karşıtı olarak kullanıldığı genel bağlamlara uyar.

error_profile.preserves: Kötülüğün karşıtı olan olumlu değer yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Herkesçe arzulanma ile yarar ve üstünlük yönlerini tek başına belirtmez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Olumlu değerin özellikle zararın karşısında ve fayda sağlayan yönüyle öne çıktığı bağlamlara uyar.

error_profile.preserves: Zararın karşısındaki fayda sağlayan yönü korur.
error_profile.loses: Kötülüğün karşıtı olan daha geniş ahlaki ve değer bildiren kapsamı dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: iyilik; yarar veya üstünlük taşıyan olumlu şey

error_profile.preserves: Daha iyi olana yönelme düşüncesini dolaylı olarak çağrıştırabilir.
error_profile.loses: Genel olumlu değer, kötülüğe karşıtlık ve yarar kapsamını kaybeder.
error_profile.adds: Birden çok seçenek arasında karar verme eylemini anlamın merkezine ekler.
error_profile.collision: Aynı kökün seçme ve seçilme dalıyla karışır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kötülüğün karşıtı olan genel olumlu değeri ve arzu edilirliği kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Fayda sağlama ve zararın karşıtı olma ilişkisini anlamın doğrudan çekirdeği yapar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de olumlu sonuç, fayda ve zarardan uzaklık alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yararı içine alabilen daha geniş bir iyilik değeridir; komşu dal ise doğrudan fayda sağlama ilişkisini anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yarar yönü öne çıkabilen her türlü genel olumlu değeri kapsayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Düzgünlük, sakınma ve yaratıcıya bağlılıkla ilgili davranış alanını özellikle kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da iyilik ve olumlu davranış değeri alanında kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genel değer kategorisidir; komşu dal bu değeri inanç ve davranıştaki düzgünlük ve bağlılıkla somutlaştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir kişi veya nesneye yüklenmeden de var olan genel iyilik değerini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Belirli bir kişi veya şeyin üstün, iyi ya da seçkin oluşunu niteleme konusu yapar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de olumlu değer değerlendirmesi alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal soyut ve genel iyiliktir; komşu dal bu değeri taşıdığı düşünülen kişi veya şeyin niteliğidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Cömertlikten bağımsız olarak arzu edilen her türlü olumlu değeri kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İyiliği verme, armağan etme ve kişide cömertlik bolluğu olarak somutlaştırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Cömertlik olumlu ve arzu edilen bir iyilik türü olduğundan iki dal kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal üst kavram niteliğindeki genel iyiliktir; komşu dal bunun verme ve armağanla belirlenen özel görünümüdür.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الخير العام المرغوب فيه، وضد الشر، وما فيه نفع أو فضل أو صلاح، والخير المطلق والمقيد، ومقابلته للشر أو الضر.
branches.source_phrase_ar: فالخير خلاف الشر لأن كل أحد يميل إليه (maqayis)؛ الخير ضد الشر (jamhara;sihah)؛ الخير ما يرغب فيه الكل وضده الشر (mufradat)؛ يقابل به الشر مرة والضر مرة (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه وصف الإنسان أو الشيء بأنه خير أو خيرة أو خيار أو أخيار، بمعنى الفضل والصلاح والجمال والميسم والاختيار من غير رذالة.
يدخل فيه الخيار والاختيار والتخير والاستخارة وخار الله لك وخيرته بين شيئين، أي طلب ما هو خير، أو الاصطفاء، أو تفويض الخيار.
يدخل فيه إطلاق الخير على المال، وبخاصة المال الكثير أو المجتمع من وجه محمود، وما يوصى به أو ينفق.
يدخل فيه الخير بمعنى الكرم، والهبة والعطاء، وكثرة الخير في الشخص.
يدخل فيه استخارة الضبع أو اليربوع بجعل خشبة أو نحوها في موضع من جحره حتى يخرج من موضع آخر.

root_profile.summary: Kökün anlam örgüsü, genel olarak arzulanan iyilikten kişi ve şeylerdeki üstünlüğe, daha iyi olanı seçmeye, mala ve cömertçe vermeye uzanır. Bunlardan ayrı duran özel bir dal ise yuvasındaki bir geçit engellenen hayvanı başka çıkıştan dışarı yöneltmeyi anlatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Dalın kaynak ifadesi, yardım sağlayan kişi ya da şeyi, yardım etme eylemini, yardım istemeyi ve karşılıklı yardımlaşmayı aynı anlam alanında açıkça toplar. Geçici çerçeve bu çekirdeği doğru yansıtır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın yardım ve destek çekirdeğini korurken yardım isteme ve karşılıklı yardımlaşma gibi yapıya bağlı kullanımları ayrı yönler olarak sınırlar.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin, topluluğun ya da aracın bir işi gerçekleştirmede başkasına güç, destek veya kolaylık sağlamasıdır. Bu çekirdek, yardım istemeyi, birlikte karşılıklı yardım etmeyi ve yardımsever kişi nitelemesini de türemiş kullanımlar olarak kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir kişi, topluluk veya şey, başka birinin işini yapmasına destek olur ya da o işte kullanılabilecek bir destek oluşturur.
Yapıya bağlı kullanımlarda kişi başkasından yardım ister veya taraflar birbirlerine yardım ederek birlikte hareket eder.
Aynı anlam alanı, insanlara çok yardım eden kişiyi ve yardım etme eylemini adlandıran türemiş biçimleri de içerir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği yardım, destek sağlama, başkasından destek isteme ve tarafların birbirine yardım etmesidir; yardım sağlayan şey de bu alanın içinde değerlendirilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın yardım sağlama çekirdeği ile karşılıklı yardımlaşma yönünü birlikte veren genel kavram karşılığıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Yardım sağlama, destek olma ve karşılıklı hareket etme çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin belirli birinden destek talep ettiği yapıya bağlı kullanımda doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Destek talep eden kişi ile yardım kaynağı arasındaki yönü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Birden çok tarafın karşılıklı destek vererek birlikte hareket ettiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Karşılıklılık ve ortak hareket etme özelliklerini eksiksiz biçimde korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, yardımın özellikle verme, bağış veya yolcuya gereç sağlama yoluyla gerçekleşmesini kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, yardımcı şeyleri, yardım talebini ve tarafların karşılıklı desteğini açıkça içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, bir işte peşinden gitme ve belirli bir bağlılık ya da dua kalıbını da içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir kişiye veya işe destek olma anlamında belirgin biçimde kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dalın izleme ve kalıplaşmış bağlılık yönleri odak dalın çekirdeğinde yoktur; odak dalın yardım isteme ve karşılıklılık kapsamı da daha geniştir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal olağan işlerde sağlanan desteği, yardım istemeyi ve dayanışmayı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, çağrı üzerine sıkıntıdan kurtarma veya acil imdada yetişme koşuluyla sınırlıdır.

branches.what_is_ar: العين الجارحة التي يبصر بها الناظر، وجمعها أعين وعيون وأعيان، وما يتصل بها من البصر والنظر.
العيان والمعاينة والرؤية بالعين، ولقاء الشيء أو فعله على عين ويقين.

عين الماء والينبوع والمنبع الجاري أو الظاهر للعيون، وما اشتق منه من ماء معين وعين القطر.
الثقب أو الموضع الرقيق في السقاء أو الجلد أو القربة، وما يسيل منه الماء أو ينسد بصب الماء.
عين الشمس، أي جرمها أو مستديرها وصيخدها كما نصت المصادر.
العين في الركبة والركية والقوس والميزان من جهة النقرة أو الموضع أو الميل الظاهر المشبه بالعين.
العين من السحاب أو الجهة عن يمين قبلة العراق، وما يتصل بها من مطر العين أو المطر الدائم أياما.
العين بمعنى المال الحاضر أو النقد أو الدينار أو الذهب، في مقابلة الدين والغائب.
العينة والسلف والشراء بنسيئة أو بيع العينة الذي يحصل به النقد لطالبه.
عين الشيء بمعنى ذاته ونفسه وتخصيصه من الجملة، كدرهمك بعينه وأعيان الدراهم.
العين والعينة بمعنى خيار الشيء وجودته وأفضله.
أعيان القوم أي أشرافهم، وأعيان الإخوة أو بني الأعيان لمن يجمعهم أب وأم أو امرأة واحدة بحسب نص المصدر.
العين والعيناء والأعين وما دل على سعة العين وحسنها، ومنه بقر الوحش والحور العين بحسب نصوص المصادر.
العين بمعنى أحد أو إنسان أو أهل الدار أو جماعة حاضرة، كقولهم ما بها عين وجاء في عين.

facets.statement: Zayıflığın karşıtı olan güç, dayanıklılık ve bir işi yapabilme yeterliğidir.

Bükülmüş ipin tek bir kolu ve bu kolların toplamı, birleşik sağlamlığın somut örneğidir.
Sağlam beden yapısı ve bir işte kararlı, tedbirli davranma bu gücün özel görünümleridir.
